bull.probability_evidence: Q2 2026 revenue growth accelerated to +14.1% YoY and S&M fell from 33.5% of revenue (2023) to 20.5% (2025), evidence the network effect is reducing the need to buy growth (note §2; GlobeNewsWire 2026-09-21 release); the net-cash balance sheet funds an annual dividend (adopted Aug 2025) and repeated buyback authorizations that could support a re-rating (note §5, 20-F).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between fact sheet Fair value bull-case anchors: DCF 216.20 vs EV/Revenue 279.28 HKD (factsheet Fair value table) = 31.54 HKD; /131.83 target = 0.2393, below the 0.379 residual-vol cap (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

base.probability_evidence: The stock already trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple (P/FCF 10.8x vs 5y min 15.0x; EV/EBITDA 7.2x vs 5y min 15.0x; factsheet Valuation table) while the -36.2% 12-month decline despite improving ROCE/margins (factsheet Price and Quality tables) signals a VIE/HFCAA risk discount (note §6, 20-F) that the base case assumes only partly closes (re-rate to the 5y P/FCF minimum, not to the mechanical 131.83 base fair value).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between fact sheet Fair value base-case anchors: DCF 100.58 vs EV/Revenue 194.35 HKD (factsheet Fair value table) = 46.885 HKD; /83.30 target = 0.5629, capped at the 0.379 residual-vol ceiling (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended) per the band rule.

bear.probability_evidence: Shares outstanding rose 4.74% YoY even with buybacks (factsheet Other table), the 2026-09-01 change of directors' executive positions is unexplained (GlobeNewsWire), and the portfolio already holds HKG:9999, adding correlated China-VIE exposure that could fall on one regulatory headline (evaluation Bear case); the 20-F names HFCAA/PCAOB inspection and VIE-enforceability as risks that could keep the price near the 52-week low of 48.36 (factsheet Price table).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between fact sheet Fair value bear-case anchors: DCF 39.48 vs EV/Revenue 136.28 HKD (factsheet Fair value table) = 48.40 HKD; /48.36 target = 1.0008, capped at the 0.379 residual-vol ceiling (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended) per the band rule.

jumps.name: Large negative earnings reaction
jumps.reason: Kanzhun's quarterly results have produced outsized share-price reactions (e.g. the Q2 2024 report), and the note's invalidation triggers are all tied to quarterly margin/growth figures that could disappoint (note §4).
jumps.cite: note §4 'What would prove this wrong' (margin/growth triggers checked each quarter); mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks
